activity_summary: At two you were on in the Shrew. The house was an ordinary afternoon house. You did not name the part, and nothing in your hand named it. Kemp got a laugh on a line that was already written, and he did not ask for another. You did not write one. No new tally was opened.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Played, unnamed the part, and wrote no new line.

entities.name: Will Kemp
entities.context: Took the laugh that was already written, and did not ask for another.
